        ### Question

As background highlights, hypertension, well controlled diet and cognitive impairment in the last year under study by his neurologist. Emergency cranial CT demonstrates a left frontal lobar hematoma without contrast enhancement. What is the most likely cause of the hematoma?

opc. Vasculitis isolated from the nervous system.
opd. Brain tumor.
ope. Amyloid cerebral angiopathy (congophilic angiopathy).
